l.i: larmino ad erroris sui patrocinium citari.
Beati Pauli dictum, Scimus idolum nihil esse in mundo, pro Bellarmino nihil facere: nec simile ex apocrypha appendice libri Esther ab Hieronymo citatum.
Hieronymum crebra comparatione hæresis cum idolo non modò non probare Bellarmini somnium, sed etiam refutare.
Propriam & primariam significationem Græcæ vocis, εἴδωλον, à Bellarmino per versissimè ad commenti sui defensionem torqueri.
Latinum simulacri nomen imaginibus pari fraude & falsitate à Bellarmino denegari, atque Græcum εἰδώλ[?].

page.notes: Section numerals V to VIII are set as bare numbers, so they are written as paragraphs, not headings. The Greek in section VII (εἴδωλον) and the final Greek word of section VIII (read as εἰδώλ[?]) are hard to read; the last letter is doubtful. Hyphenated line-end words were joined: "citari", "facere", "appendice", "Bellarmini", "denegari". Long s was normalised to s and u/v to v where it is a consonant. No printing errors were corrected.
